purpose: Admin observability of the fetched top-N pg_stat_statements query fingerprints, execution costs and shared-buffer efficiency.
primaryGoal: Identify individually slow, aggregate-costly or I/O-bound SQL queries, compare their metrics, and inspect/export the fetched evidence without implying a complete historical analysis.

dataSources.contract: SlowQueriesResponse.order_by and slow_queries; rows contain query_id, fingerprint, calls, total_time_ms, mean_time_ms, max_time_ms, rows_returned and optional/null shared_blks_hit/shared_blks_read (web\src\types\admin-operator-confidence.ts:53-74). Milliseconds are the current explicitly named source contract; this audit does not authorize wire renaming.
dataSources.policy: Key ['admin','observability','slow-queries',orderBy,limit] (hook:78-79); AbortSignal forwarded to request (127-132); STALE_TIMES.MODERATE, INTERVALS.STANDARD, background polling disabled, retry=1 (134-137). Comment describes STANDARD as 30 seconds; constants themselves were not inspected.
dataSources.scope: Page-owned non-date order/limit only, defaults mean_time and 25 (useSlowQueriesPage.ts:16-19). No vehicle/date selector is rendered; no invented server date bounds.
dataSources.derivations: Single response drives all sections: fetched-row aggregates, selected-metric top 12 ranking and lowest known cache-hit top 8 (useSlowQueriesPage.ts:38-82). Cache percentages are hit/(hit+read)*100, null when denominator is nonpositive (helpers.ts:37-48).
dataSources.unknowns: Live endpoint not invoked. Repository filtering, counter reset epoch, completeness, backend cap implementation, null payload behavior and authentication outcomes not verified. No deeper backend trace was performed.

states.initialLoading: useSlowQueriesPage.ts:21,27 uses deriveDataState initial status; Summary loading suppresses numbers, ChartCard owns loading, cache Skeleton=260, details Skeleton=280. Paused initial fetching remains initial; shared notices/freshness receive the query.
states.success: All sections always mounted (SlowQueriesPage.tsx:84-100); six metrics plus ranking/cache/table display from the same payload.
states.empty: Resolved empty rows produce a known count/call/time zero summary, an empty ranking, no-cache notice and pg_stat_statements empty explanation in details (SlowQueriesDetails.tsx:88-97). Empty payload and unknown field values must remain distinct.
states.fatalError: Only fatalError without retained data drives showError (useSlowQueriesPage.ts:20-27; dataState.ts:140-147,206-222); Summary, ranking, cache and table retain independent retry affordances.
states.unsupported: Any fatal API 503 is classified as subsystemMissing (useSlowQueriesPage.ts:21). Page renders localized extension/shared_preload_libraries guidance and removes dataSources notice (SlowQueriesPage.tsx:70-81). query freshness remains passed. Summary is unmeasured; analysis shows ordinary empty states; details renders an empty DataTable.
states.refreshing: Retained query payload remains; summary is marked retained during refresh or stale status (SlowQueriesPage.tsx:88). Shared header receives full query; no page-wide loading gate is supplied.
states.staleOffline: dataState.ts:163-177 retains data on refresh error or paused fetch; fatalError stays null. Header query/dataSources remain connected. Summary retained label is used for stale state. Actual stale/offline display and retry behavior are not browser-tested.
states.partialUnknown: No explicit deriveDataState partial/unavailable options or source age threshold supplied (useSlowQueriesPage.ts:20). Optional buffer counters are coalesced to zero before ratio calculation; null total denominator returns no ratio. Known envelope does not itself prove every measurement known.
states.disabled: Selectors remain available while loading/error; options have no disabled flag. Chart controls are not opted in. Shared table export disablement depends on filtered row count (DataTable.tsx:908-913). No mutations exist.

issues.detail: Optional nullable shared_blks_hit/read are independently replaced by zero. A row with one absent counter and one positive counter can be displayed as a measured 0% or 100%, although the ratio is not fully known. The aggregate repeats this coalescing at useSlowQueriesPage.ts:52-53 and may imply complete known efficiency.
issues.fix: Preserve source counters and explicitly distinguish complete ratios from unavailable/partial evidence; use null/missing metadata rather than fabricating a missing counter. Keep existing totals and source scope visible and resolve payload meaning before changing business arithmetic.

issues.detail: Cache row label accesses row.fingerprint.length unconditionally, despite the adjacent display and ariaLabel using a missing-string fallback. Types require string, so actual null/absent server fingerprints are not proven; a malformed payload could crash this component.
issues.fix: Derive a safe fingerprint once and reuse it for clipping, Code and accessible naming; retain query identity and full known SQL. Verify backend nullability rather than adding a broad untyped adapter.

visualIssues.detail: Bar cells cycle CHART_COLORS by row index even though each bar is the same selected metric. Multiple hues encode arbitrary order rather than domain meaning, creating a source-level rainbow risk; actual persisted chart palette/rendering was not inspected.
visualIssues.fix: Use one existing subdued chart accent for ranking and reserve semantic hues for meaningful cache thresholds; preserve user-selected chart palette preferences where required by the shared owner.

visualIssues.detail: Feature supplies three hardcoded hex threshold colors; MetricBar defaults to an animated gradient (MetricBar.tsx:46,93). Cache icon also uses fixed text-cyan-300 (59), rather than a theme-aware neutral or semantic token.
visualIssues.fix: Keep >=90 and >=50 threshold meanings, but supply existing success/warning/danger theme variables with MetricBar fill=solid and a restrained semantic/neutral icon token. Do not pass CSS variables into the gradient suffix path or create a new palette.

visualIssues.detail: Both chart axes hardcode fontSize 10, and the Y-axis takes 150px (48). This bypasses the shared typography scale and may leave narrow charts cramped; clipping and contrast are unverified.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing chart/typography tokens and a source-preserving responsive axis layout, retaining full fingerprints in the accessible table and detail table. Validate 320px/long SQL rather than hiding data.

architectureIssues.detail: Feature imports StatMetric through a deep stat-reference path and MetricDisplayOptions through metric-reference (5); the production components themselves use category barrels. This is a type-only import concern, not proof of runtime cycles or a missing barrel export.
architectureIssues.fix: Use the existing canonical public type export if available; if unavailable, integration owner should confirm the intended type path before any shared export change. No speculative new barrel API is required by this audit.

architectureIssues.detail: Every fatal 503 is described as pg_stat_statements not installed; handler's precise error-to-503 discrimination was not traced. A transient 503 could be misrepresented if it uses the same transport status.
architectureIssues.fix: Confirm the existing handler error code/unsupported contract and distinguish unsupported from transient failure using that contract, preserving retry and extension guidance. Do not invent a backend status or new endpoint.

Preserve positive-denominator cache rows, ascending hit percentage/top-8, full SQL plus clipped 30-character labels and >=90/>=50 threshold meanings.
Preserve number precision/locale and adaptive latency display; convert milliseconds to seconds only for the existing latency metric boundary, never in wire/cache.
Keep every section and explanatory state visible, including source-limited summary scope and the explicit absence of observation time/complete analysis bounds.
Preserve fatal-versus-refresh error distinction and retained data for background failures/offline; do not turn unknown data into successful zero.
